Hi Priya, Alex — thanks, I pulled the workbook and started a control intake. I've attached an initial control mapping (redwood_control_map_v1.csv) and a SOC 2 architecture snapshot (soc2-snapshot-arch-diagram.pdf).

Notes on mapping (summary):
- We marked controls where Redwood provides direct coverage vs. controls where customer configuration is required. Each row has an assigned internal owner and the recommended artifact type (policy excerpt, console screenshot, log extract, or third-party attestation).
- For encryption key custody we reference our KMS flow and HSM integrations — I attached the diagram to show key provenance.
- Log retention: production inference logs are retained in our centralized logging cluster (region-us-logs) for 180 days; audit logs for user actions in Console are retained for 365 days by default. We'll provide a sample log extract and a snippet of the retention policy.

Outstanding scoping questions for AegisTech: 
- Is AegisTech planning to validate tenant-level configuration controls (app-layer isolation) or only tenant separation via dedicated deployment?
- Do you require network-level evidence (VPC peering/flow logs) in addition to application audit logs?

Attachments: redwood_control_map_v1.csv (text/csv), soc2-snapshot-arch-diagram.pdf (application/pdf)

I can deliver the first tranche (policy excerpts + log sample + mapping) by end of day 6/19, and the full packet by 6/22 if scoping is clarified.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa, Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and the diagram. To be explicit on scoping: the buyer will consider application-layer tenant isolation as in-scope for controls that cover authentication, authorization, and role separation. They also want network-level evidence for controls tied to network segmentation and ingress/egress monitoring.

So next deliverables requested:
- Updated control mapping showing which controls require network-level artifacts.
- Sample console audit log (redacted) for a tenant admin action.
- VPC flow log extract for a 24h window and a short note describing retention and access controls.

We'll take the first tranche by 6/22; appreciate your estimated deliveries. Also confirm whether Redwood will allow a short live demo of audit log playback during our intake call (masked data).

Best,
Priya Shah
Procurement Lead — AegisTech Solutions
